quality.seasonalEligibilityRule: At least 75% valid hourly readings in every UTC meteorological season
quality.exclusionReason: One or more seasons have less than 75% valid hourly readings; available observations are retained
quality.missingTreatment: null; no interpolation, imputation, or substitution of a different monitor
quality.sourcePrecisionNote: Concentrations serialized to three decimal places
quality.spatialScope: One monitoring location; not a citywide or population-weighted exposure estimate
quality.sourceTimestamps: Offset-aware measurement timestamps retained at reported UTC hour without rounding
quality.license: US Public Domain as shown on the OpenAQ location page
quality.ratificationStatus: Not supplied in archived AirNow/OpenAQ rows
quality.selectionReason: Same OpenAQ location8833 and PM2.5 sensor25754; gaps and the 2025 cessation retained
quality.sourceCoverageNote: All seasons contain observations, but February has only 10.7% hourly capture and March 49.2%. Do not interpret the available-hour mean as a complete annual comparison.
quality.qaStatus: The same monitor has major winter/spring gaps in 2023. February has 10.7% and March 49.2% hourly capture. Source rows do not supply ratification or quality flags.
quality.partialYearNote: Gaps in the same-monitor archive are retained; consult monthly and seasonal coverage.
